content: git filter-repo --path X --invert-paths strips path X from every commit's tree across all reachable refs (branches+tags by default); multiple --path flags combine as a union with one --invert-paths (official example: git filter-repo --path foo.zip --path bar/baz/zips/ --invert-paths). Commits that become empty after path removal are pruned by default (--prune-empty auto), children re-parented. History rewrite is irreversible: reflogs and old objects are pruned immediately. refs/stash handling is documented but described by maintainers as opaque/error-prone, especially on mirror clones (newren/git-filter-repo issue #652) — safest to git stash drop before running. Requires --force unless run on a freshly packed clone with single origin remote.
